senses.gloss:
Kañcaṃ_Yallayārya
See below under Yallayārya.

Kañcanaśreṣṭhyādikathā
Jain. Jainagranthāvalī p. 248.

Kañcirāja
Mopāṭi, of Śrīvatsa gotra; mentioned a. a. ancestor of Varadarājadeśika alias Kṛṣṇadāsa, in the latter's Nityakriyāratnamālā, dh. MT. 1860.

Kañjivallīya_Kuberaśarman
IO. i. p. 475a. See Kuberaśarman. [Page118-b]

Kāñcana
son of Nārāyaṇa Vāgīśvara, of Kāpya Gotra, who became a sannyāsin; a scholar named Gadādhara is mentioned in the prologue of his play. A king Jayadeva (another reading Jagaddeva) is also mentioned; attempts have been made to identify this king, who might even be fictitious. Kāñcana is earlier than the 15th century, a. a ms. of his play is d. 1431 A. D.
--Dhanañjayavijaya Vyāyoga.
Pt.. K. M. 54. 1895.

Kāñcana_Yalla
--Jyautiṣadarpaṇa. Śg. II. 42. See under Yallaya, Kañcam.

Kāñcanapatināmadhāraṇī
Bud. Lalou p. 21. See below Kāñcavatīdhāraṇī.

Kāñcanamālinī
kāvya (?) Q. in Khaṇḍanoddhāra of Vācaspati Miśra II of Mithilā (p. 25 edn. in Pandit 1903-7). See J. of G. Jha Res. Inst. IV. i-iv. p. 304.

Kāñcanamālī
looks like a didactic poem; q. in the Smṛtiratnākara of Hārīta Veṅkaṭācārya (p. 210, Venk. edn.). C.. previous entry. See Annals of Ori. Res. Uni. of Madras, I. i-ii. p. 18.

Kāñcavatīdhāraṇī
Bud. AMG. II. p. 325. AR. XX. p. 526.

Kāñcīkāmakoṭipīṭhādhipajagadguruvyāsapūjāmahotsava
by Pañcāpageśa Śāstrin.
Pt.. Kumbhakonam, 1919. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1246. [Page299-b]

Kāñcīkāmākṣīstotra
Sri. Dev. 255.

Kāñcīdevādirājasvāmibrahmotsavapañcaviśatistotra
by Veṅkaṭanātha Vedānta Deśika.
Pt.. Grantha script, Kuppam, 1918. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1245.

Kāñcīnātha
--C. Dīpikā on Ratirahasya of Kokkoka. Pt.. Panjab Skt. Bk. Depot, Lahore.

Kāñcīpūrṇa
known in Tamil a. Tirukkaccinambi, son of Kamalāpati; pupil of Yāmunācārya an. one of the five religious teachers of Rāmānujācārya.
--Devarājāṣṭaka or Varadarājāṣṭaka, also called Kāñcīpūrṇastotra or Kāñcīstotra. Adyar I. p. 198b. MT. 174 (j). 6246. 6313.
Pt.. (1) Stotraratnākara, Vol. II. p. 32. (2) Stotramālā, Kancipuram, 1948, p. 10.

Kāñcīprativādibhayaṅkaramaṭhaguruparamparā
Pt.. Conjeevaram, 1929. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1246.

Kāñcībhāṇa
name sometimes given to Vasantatilakabhāṇa or Ammāl Bhāṇa of Varadācārya; also of a. Bhāṇa of Veṅkaṭādhvarin (a. inc. ms. with a descendent of a.) which is probably entitled Madanadīpikā or Śṛṅgāradīpikā.
See J. of Sri. Venk. Ori. Inst. II. i. 1941. p.. 69-71.

Kāñcī(kṣetra)māhātmya,_Kā._Sthalaº,_Kā._Sthānaº
on the famous city Kāñcī in South India, its Śiva, Viṣṇu an. Devī temples, sacred waters an. legends.
Unidentified text: Gough p. 171. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 16. Mad. Uni. 522 (c). Oppert II. 57. 4512. Rice 82. Śṛṅgerī Mutt 268. [Page300-a.
--from Purāṇasaṅgraha. Mysore I. p. 110 (9 chs. inc.). See also IO. 6935 in entry after next.
--from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa in 32 chs. BC. 300. IO. 6663. MD. 15705 (inc. 28 chs.). On the Viṣṇukṣetras especially.
Pt.. (1) P. B. Annangarachariar, Śāstramuktāvalī 26, Conjeevaram, 1906. (2) with Kannada transl., Śrī Jaya Cāmarājendra Grantharatnamālā 18. Mysore, 1945.
--Śaiva-purāṇa-saṅgraha; from different purāṇas, Brahmāṇḍa etc.; probably the text in 100 chs. ref. to a. Śatādhyāya, an. transl. into Tamil a. Kāñcippurāṇam, p.. II. by Kacciappamunivar. IO. 6935 (Col. Sarvapurāṇasaṅgraha).
--from Skandapurāṇa, Tīrthapraśaṁsā section of Sanatkumārasaṁhitā of Kālikākhaṇḍa; text in 50 chs. an. hence ref. to a. Pañcāśat; transl. into Tamil a. Kāñcippurāṇam Pt. I, by Śivajñānayogin of Tiruvāvaḍuturai Maṭh (ptd. Madras, 1910).
Alwar 772. BC. 134 (from Śaṅkarīsaṁhitā). IO. 6847. MD. 2381. 2382 (inc.). MT. 909. Mysore I. p. 180. Taylor II. 240.

Kāñcīśāradāmaṭhajagadguruparamparāstotra
by Sudarśanendra Sarasvatī.
Pt.. along with 3 other works, Maṭhāmnāya etc. in Telugu script, Madras, 1894.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 1246, 1594.

Kāñcīśrīprativādibhayaṅkarāryavaṃśaguruparamparā
or Nityānusandheyaguruparamparā. a series of 41 taniya or hagiological verses. [Page300-b]
Pt.. (1) with Hindi rubrics, Ajmere, 1905. (2) with some additional verses, Conjeevaram, 1910.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 776. C.. above Kāñcīprativādiº

Kāñcīstotra
Adyar I. p. 198b. See under Devarājāṣṭaka of Kāñcīpūrṇa.

Kāñcīhastigirimāhātmya
from Śeṣadharma.
Pt.. in Telugu script, Madras, 1867. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1245.

Kāñcikapūjā
Jain. Dig. by Kumudacandra. BORI. 576 of 1875-76. D. p. 107 (inc.). Report XXXVII.
Pt.. See Arrah I-A. p. 40.

Kāñjikāvratopākhyāna
Jain.
Pt.. See Arrah I-A. p. 40.

Kāñjīdvādaśyudyāpana
Jain. by Khuśāl Paṇḍita.
See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XIII. i. p. 35.
